description: Perform live HTTP GET and analyze security headers: CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Permissions-Policy, Referrer-Policy. Use to audit live website headers; use check_headers to validate headers you already have. Free: 30/hr, Pro: 500/hr. By default header values are truncated to 500 chars (CSP can exceed 4 KB on large sites); pass include='full' for the full raw value. Returns {headers_present, headers_missing, findings, total_score}.

domain.description: Domain to scan live HTTP headers for (e.g. 'example.com', 'api.github.com')
domain.title: Domain

include.description: Detail level. Default ('') returns slim findings — raw header values capped at 500 chars with total_value_length carrying the honest pre-truncation length. Pass 'full' to restore the full raw value (useful for inspecting full CSP directives on sites like GitHub where the CSP header exceeds 4 KB). Allowed: '' or 'full'.
include.title: Include

name: scan_headers
